args.request: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy.

beats.text: Medium shot: the young woman walks up to the park bench, touches the wet seat with her hand and frowns slightly.
The older man walks up beside her, smiles kindly and holds out his folded newspaper, offering it for her to sit on.
Wide shot: the two sit side by side on the bench on the spread newspaper, glance at each other and share a warm, gentle smile.
